_about: Mechanic catalogue (issue #24). type=mechanic is one atomic rule; type=composition is a move or ability that lists the mechanics it uses; type=calc is damage-calculator cases. Many case stubs per entry. Stubs are plain-words scenarios, not runnable cases yet. status: ok = source confirms it; verify = needs checking before the case is written. In a composition, involves lists the mechanics a stub needs and must be a subset of uses.

mechanics.name: Move priority and turn order
mechanics.rule: Within a turn, actions resolve by priority bracket first, then Speed (highest first), then a seeded random tie-break. Trick Room reverses Speed, not priority. Abilities and moves can block priority moves or reorder within a bracket (Queenly Majesty, Armor Tail, Quick Guard, Stall).
source: smogon: Champions Battle Mechanics Research thread (Mega Evolution order is not purely Speed-based)

cases.expect: Fake Out still goes first (Trick Room reverses Speed, not priority)

mechanics.name: Flinch
mechanics.rule: A flinch makes the target lose its move this turn if it has not acted yet. It is a secondary effect, so Shield Dust and Sheer Force interfere. It clears at the end of the turn. Inner Focus prevents it, and Steadfast turns it into Speed +1.
source: showdown: data/conditions.ts#flinch (not read yet; fetch in S0)
repo: 20 moves in data/moves.json mention flinch

mechanics.name: Type immunity
mechanics.rule: A move of a type the target is immune to deals no damage and applies no effects, including secondaries and self-drops. Some abilities lift an immunity (Scrappy lets Normal and Fighting hit Ghost).
source: showdown: sim/battle-actions.ts#runImmunity, #spreadMoveHit (self-drops skipped for immune targets)

mechanics.name: Protect
mechanics.rule: Protect-family moves (+4 priority) block moves that have the protect flag for the turn they are used. Some moves and effects pass through. Wide Guard blocks only spread moves and Quick Guard only priority moves.
source: smogon: Champions Battle Mechanics Research thread (Piercing Drill and Unseen Fist ignore Protect for 1/4 damage)

cases.expect: blocked, no flinch

mechanics.name: Stat stages
mechanics.rule: Stages run from -6 to +6 for Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy and evasion. They reset when the mon switches out.

mechanics.name: Foe-caused stat drop
mechanics.rule: A stat drop caused by a foe (Intimidate, Snarl, Parting Shot) can be blocked (Clear Body, White Smoke, Hyper Cutter), flipped (Contrary, Mirror Armor), reacted to (Defiant, Competitive) and bottoms out at -6. Self-caused drops (Close Combat) do not trigger Defiant or Competitive.

mechanics.name: Entry triggers
mechanics.rule: When a mon enters (battle start, switch-in, KO replacement, or a Mega form gaining an ability) its entry abilities fire in Speed order. Entry abilities in the data include Intimidate, the weather and terrain setters, Trace, Imposter, Frisk, Anticipation and Forewarn.
